groups._comment: PM/AM report grouping. NewMile truck TAGS are NOT exposed via the MCP, so subhaulers (fleet null) are grouped by owner-name rules + per-owner overrides. Edit freely. Groups: KT (Kennemer fleet 6), CE (Cactus fleet 5), AGGCT (AGGSHIP + Central Texas, combined), CKJ_SUB (CKJ-affiliated subs), SUB (other subhaulers).
